booking.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/judith-landing ('Campsites are on a first-come, first-serve basis — NO RESERVATIONS'; Stay Limit '14 Days'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/judith-landing ('Judith Landing Campground is open from May 15 to October 15, annually.'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/judith-landing ('There are eight (8) sites that can accommodate trailers or recreational vehicles (RVs) up to 40 feet in length.'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/judith-landing ('There are no hookups available.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Trash dumpsters. Fire ring and picnic table at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.blm.gov/visit/judith-landing ('The campground is equipped with vault toilets and trash dumpsters. There is no water available in the campground.'), read 2026-10-22

note: BLM campground (Lewistown Field Office) in the Upper Missouri River Breaks National Monument, on the Wild & Scenic Missouri at the PN Bridge: MT Hwy 236 south from Big Sandy (44 mi, ~17 paved then improved gravel), or ~23 mi of improved gravel (PN Road) north from Winifred. Popular river launch; boaters floating the river pay a separate per-person river fee. --Claude
summary: BLM page confirms FCFS (no reservations), 8 sites to 40 ft, no hookups, vault toilets, no water, May 15 - Oct 15; added fees $20/night (entry had none) and the 14-day stay limit. Operated by BLM Lewistown Field Office.
